interface.signature: def decrypt(encrypted_text: str, n: int) -> str

preconditions.expression: isinstance(encrypted_text, str) or encrypted_text is None
preconditions.description: The input encrypted_text must be a string or None.
The input n must be an integer.

postconditions.expression: (encrypted_text is None or encrypted_text == '') and return_value == encrypted_text
postconditions.description: If the input string is None or empty, the function returns the input unchanged.
If n is less than or equal to 0, the function returns the input string unchanged.
If n > 0 and encrypted_text is the result of applying encrypt(original_text, n), then decrypt returns the original_text.
